run_break_on_failure_test: run the googletest break-on-failure unit test to verify segfault behavior on assertion failure
test_break_on_failure_env_var: test the GTEST_BREAK_ON_FAILURE environment variable controls segfault on assertion failure
test_break_on_failure_flag: test the --gtest_break_on_failure CLI flag controls segfault on assertion failure
test_flag_overrides_env_var: test that the --gtest_break_on_failure flag overrides the GTEST_BREAK_ON_FAILURE env var
run_and_verify_segfault: run the test executable and verify whether it segfaults based on env var and flag settings
